_meta.scope: Top 20 flagged search terms by spend (last 30 days, refreshed Oct 5 2026).
_meta.rule: Rule (Alex, Oct 5 2026): the owner is the ad group that takes most of the term's spend in that geo. Recommend an ad-group negative only where another ad group in the same geo spent >= $100 or >= 5% of the term's total spend. The same keyword in other geo campaigns doesn't count as cannibalization. Several keywords inside one ad group isn't something a negative can fix. Below the threshold = No action.

Competitors|trello: Each geo has one owner ([trello] exact in 'trello'). The only other spend is US 'trello project management theme' at $99, under the threshold.
Optional: WW comp1 has no trello keyword. The 'atlassian' phrase keyword catches it there (8.3K impr, $314, 4 conv, ~$78/conv vs ~$196 overall). Add [trello] exact to WW comp1.
